title: A BLANKED SECTOR LINE TAKES NO ROOM
why: Seen on the 4K lift screenshot of 2026-10-08: he blanked both sector description lines with his text edits, and the empty lines still left a band of space between the sector name and its facts on every card. A blank line now takes no room; with Edit the words on, it stays so it can be clicked and given words again. His words are untouched.
now: The sector cards on the lift page have no empty gap under the name.
